qa_pairs.question: What procedure is being illustrated on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: This page shows the procedure for changing toe on the right wheel, as indicated by the title 'CHANGING TOE ON 'RIGHT' WHEEL'.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 1 represent in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 1 represents the forward direction, as shown in the legend on the right side of the page.

qa_pairs.question: What are callouts 9 and 10 indicating in the adjustment diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout 9 indicates toe increase (+ direction) and callout 10 indicates toe decrease (- direction) during the adjustment procedure.

qa_pairs.question: What does the graph on the left side of the page show?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph shows the relationship between displacement angle (callout 11) and toe change (callout 12), with values ranging from 0 to 4.5 on the x-axis and 0 to 1.2 on the y-axis.

qa_pairs.question: What do callouts 5 and 6 represent according to the legend?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout 5 represents the reading point for toe increase and callout 6 represents the reading point for toe decrease.

qa_pairs.question: What is shown by callout 7 in the adjustment diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout 7 represents the trailing arm eye, as indicated in the legend.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout 8 identify in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout 8 identifies the silent block component in the suspension assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What is the BMW part number shown at the bottom of the page?
qa_pairs.answer: The BMW part number shown at the bottom of the page is 730 33 187.
